2607.05752.title: When Should LLMs Search? Counterfactual Supervision for Search Routing
2607.05752.paper_summary: Search-augmented language models can use external evidence to compensate for limitations in parametric knowledge, but search is not uniformly beneficial: models may call search for questions they can already answer, or rely on noisy evidence when correction, clarification, or abstention would be more appropriate. We formulate this as an instance-level search-routing problem: deciding whether search is needed to improve task success relative to a no-search execution. To derive supervision, we compare no-search and forced-search outcomes for the same question and construct an oracle over NO SEARCH, SEARCH, and UNSOLVED based on task-specific success. Using this oracle as both an evaluation criterion and a learning signal, we train search-routing policies with supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization, improving routing macro-F1 on oracle-eligible examples from 0.7082 to 0.8235 for Gemma E2B and from 0.7053 to 0.8365 for Qwen3.5-4B. Further analysis shows that the learned policies reduce model-specific routing failures: Gemma primarily learns no-search restraint, while Qwen further reduces missed search; residual UNSOLVED cases reveal heterogeneous bottlenecks involving model capacity, retrieval budget, evidence use, and policy behavior.
2607.05752.paper_summary_zh: 增強搜索的語言模型可以利用外部證據來彌補參數知識的限制，但搜索並非總是有益：模型可能會對它們已經能夠回答的問題進行搜索，或在更合適的情況下依賴噪音證據進行更正、澄清或放棄。我們將這個問題表述為一個實例級的搜索路由問題：決定是否需要搜索以改善相對於無搜索執行的任務成功率。為了獲取監督，我們比較對於同一問題的無搜索和強制搜索結果，並根據任務特定的成功構建一個關於無搜索、搜索和未解決的預言者。將這個預言者作為評估標準和學習信號，我們通過有監督的微調和偏好優化訓練搜索路由策略，將Gemma E2B的路由宏觀F1從0.7082提升至0.8235，將Qwen3.5-4B的路由宏觀F1從0.7053提升至0.8365。進一步的分析顯示，學習到的策略減少了模型特定的路由失敗：Gemma主要學會了無搜索的克制，而Qwen則進一步減少了漏掉的搜索；剩餘的未解決案例揭示了涉及模型容量、檢索預算、證據使用和策略行為的異質瓶頸。
2607.05752.author: Minho Kim et.al.
